title: Licorice Root for Hair: What the Research Shows
seo_title: Licorice Root for Hair: Benefits, Evidence & Safety | FullyVital
seo_description: What research shows about licorice-containing preparations and hair, why licorice root alone is unproven, and the blood pressure and potassium cautions.
notes: Citation style v2: 3 studies, each cited once, all in the second half; Key Takeaways and FAQ carry no links.

Old post (1,533 words, 0 study links) claimed scalp health, hair growth and conditioning. Removed along with the DIY masks, rinses and product-shopping sections; the new article reports the only hair-related findings and the main safety caveat.
flags: The closing FullyVital product box (unchanged, sitewide) says products 'Promote Hair Regrowth'. Left for you, as with boron.
The Drake 2023 abstract only names 'compound glycyrrhizin tablets'; it doesn't say which hair condition or give detail. The article says it's a tablet, not root.
'In small amounts occasionally, probably' (FAQ) is a soft general statement, not directly from an abstract. Say if you want it changed to 'talk to your doctor'.
